keyPoints.en: Northern rulers were unhappy with the Bangkok Treaty 1909; Terengganu resisted a full Adviser until 1919.
keyPoints.bm: Raja negeri utara tidak puas hati dengan Perjanjian Bangkok 1909; Terengganu menolak Penasihat penuh hingga 1919.

keyPoints.en: Johor used diplomacy and accepted a General Adviser only in 1914.
keyPoints.bm: Johor menggunakan diplomasi dan hanya menerima Penasihat Am pada 1914.

keyPoints.en: Diplomacy (Sultan Abu Bakar, 1885 treaty); written constitutions (Johor 1895, Terengganu 1911); modern administration.
keyPoints.bm: Diplomasi (Sultan Abu Bakar, perjanjian 1885); perlembagaan bertulis (Johor 1895, Terengganu 1911); pentadbiran moden.

keyPoints.en: Dato' Jaafar Muhammad, first Menteri Besar of Johor, built modern administration.
keyPoints.bm: Dato' Jaafar Muhammad, Menteri Besar Johor pertama, membina pentadbiran moden.

keyPoints.en: Wan Mohd Saman (Kedah) built the Terusan Wan Mat Saman to irrigate padi fields.
keyPoints.bm: Wan Mohd Saman (Kedah) membina Terusan Wan Mat Saman untuk mengairi sawah padi.

keyPoints.en: Effects: British control delayed, rulers kept more power, Malay institutions and officials preserved.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan: kawalan British dilambatkan, raja mengekalkan lebih banyak kuasa, institusi dan pegawai Melayu dikekalkan.

tip.en: Different methods, same goal: protecting sovereignty.
tip.bm: Kaedah berbeza, matlamat sama: mempertahankan kedaulatan.
